Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. Attached is the commercial appendix for our RFP (Appendix B) — we have a few focused questions on the pricing tables and billing flows so we can align with procurement and finance. High-level asks: 

- Clear per-token price at each commit band and how overages are handled (monthly true-up vs invoice offset)
- Example invoices for both prepaid and postpaid options
- Seat-based vs token-based conversion guidance (we run both conversational agents and embedding-heavy search)
- Any minimums, caps, or automatic throttles we should know about

Can you confirm whether you can provide a single spreadsheet with: tiered token pricing, seat-to-token conversion, sample invoices, and suggested commercial protections for a 24-month term?

We'd like this back by EOD Monday to feed the procurement committee. I've attached Appendix_B_Budget.xlsx for context.

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: RFP: Commercial and Billing Model — NovaEgypt

Amira —

Appreciate the appendix. Please find an initial commercial summary below and a pricing matrix attached (redwood_pricing_matrix_v1.csv). We'll follow up with sample invoices and a short conversion table in the next message.

Executive summary (short):
- Pilot: 3-month pilot available; pilot rate = hosted API list price with a 35% pilot discount (no long-term commitment).
- Commit bands (monthly committed tokens): 0-2M, 2M-10M, 10M-50M, 50M+ with stepped per-token pricing. Larger commits get proportionally lower per-token rates.
- Billing cadence: monthly invoice with monthly true-up. Option to prepay quarterly or annually for a further 6–14% discount depending on length.
- Overages: billed monthly at the overage tier rate for the next band; customers may elect an overage cap (we can cap at +25% of committed monthly volume) for a fixed premium.
- Seat conversions: we provide a seat-to-token guidance table; for typical chat-heavy seats we estimate 40k–60k tokens/month per seat, embedding-heavy seats ~120k tokens/month. We will include a conversion appendix.
- Credits & protections: 30-day grace buffer for new pilots, invoice offset true-up after close of monthly accounting, and an annual true-up to reconcile committed vs consumed across 12 months. For 24-month deals we offer a usage smoothing clause (rollover of up to 10% of unused committed tokens per quarter).
- SLA & credits: 99.9% uptime target for dedicated capacity; SLA credits tiers included in the attached matrix.

Requested attachments included: redwood_pricing_matrix_v1.csv (per-token tiers, seat conversion table, overage logic). I'll follow up with a sample invoice PDF and a second pricing matrix with a 2-year committed discount ladder.

Proposed next step: quick call on Monday morning to walk the pricing matrix and agree which bill-path (prepay vs postpay) your finance prefers.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0199

Karthik —

Thanks, that layout is helpful. A few clarifying questions before we take this to committee: 

1) Can you provide the exact per-token numbers for the 2M–10M and 10M–50M bands (list the cents per 1k tokens for both prompt and completion tokens separately)?
2) For seat-to-token guidance, can you include a concrete conversion table we can attach to the schedule (example: 1 "customer-success" seat = 45k tokens/mo, 1 "search-indexer" seat = 130k tokens/mo)?
3) Invoice example: we need one that shows (a) committed tokens used = X, (b) overage calculation and (c) applied prepay discount if applicable.

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: FW: RFP: Commercial and Billing Model — NovaEgypt (procurement follow-up)

Team — forwarding NovaEgypt's follow-up (see below). They want explicit cents-per-1k numbers, a conversion table to lock seats to tokens for the schedule, sample invoice, and an overage cap option with premium pricing. Procurement deadline: COB Wednesday (three days).

My recommendation / negotiation playbook to hit SOC and protect margin: 

1) Offer: 24-month committed token agreement with the following blended per-1k rates (prompt/completion split):
   - 2M–10M: $7.50 per 1k prompt tokens / $12.00 per 1k completion tokens
   - 10M–50M: $5.75 per 1k prompt tokens / $9.25 per 1k completion tokens
   - Note: 0–2M and 50M+ bands follow the matrix in v1; we'll include explicit cells in v2.

2) Seat conversion table (for schedule insertion) — conservative mapping we can sign to: 
   - Customer Success (chat-heavy): 45,000 tokens/month per seat
   - Product Analyst (mixed): 75,000 tokens/month per seat
   - Search Indexer (embedding-heavy): 140,000 tokens/month per seat

3) Overage cap option: cap overage at +20% of monthly committed volume for a fixed premium of +9% on the monthly invoice; overages beyond the cap billed at standard overage rates. Cap must be elected at contract signature and adjusts quarterly.

4) Sample invoice: produce two variants — (A) monthly postpay with monthly true-up and (B) prepaid quarterly with 8% discount applied to the invoice. I'll create sample_invoice_nova.pdf and redwood_pricing_matrix_v2.csv with all numeric cells and show calculations line-by-line.

5) Concessions we can give without legal escalation: 12% flat discount on list when customer commits to 24 months and prepays at least 50% annually; 18% when prepaying 100% annually. Include a single-instance onboarding credit equal to two weeks of typical per-seat usage for migration testing.

6) Risk controls: include a smoothing clause (rollover of up to 10% unused monthly commitment, quarterly aggregation) and an annual reconciliation clause (true-up). Termination for convenience with 60-day notice and pro-rata repayment of prepaid amounts less onboarding credit.

Action items (who/when):
- Ben: please produce the two sample invoices (postpay & prepaid) and the v2 pricing CSV with detailed cells by EOD Tuesday.
- Marissa: please review the blended rates and seat conversion mapping for commercial approval; flag if we need to move bands +/−10% to preserve margin.
- Me: I'll prepare the DocuSign schedule with the overage cap election checkbox and a short summary memo for procurement.

If you want, we can offer a one-week extension to procurement's COB deadline in exchange for agreement to a 50% prepay milestone; I'd prefer to avoid that unless needed.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_pricing_matrix_v2.csv (pricing matrix with explicit numeric cells), sample_invoice_nova.pdf (sample invoice)
